extracted.name: Easy funnel cake
extracted.description: Great recipe for Easy funnel cake.
ingredient_lines: At least 2 inches of oil for frying
instruction_lines: In a pan on the stove add oil and heat on medium heat.
In a large bowl mix all dry ingredients together very well.
Starting with 1 cup of milk add all wet ingredients to the dry. Youre looking for a loose pancake like consistency. Add more milk if its too thick.
Using a cooking funnel or any type of cup drizzle batter in a swirling motion making sure theres not a lot of space in between.
Fry on each side for around 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown.
Top with powdered sugar, chocolate sauce, caramel or any other desired topping and enjoy!!!!
